cat > programs/task-5c8b67a2.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in g for x in row), key=lambda c:sum(row.count(c) for row in g))
    # find non-background solid rectangle (the lower canvas) and patterned source above
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    # locate largest monochrome rectangular component, acts as destination placeholder
    from collections import deque
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in cells:
        if p in seen: continue
        q=[p]; seen.add(p); comp=[]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and n not in seen and g[n[0]][n[1]]==g[r][c]:
                    seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    comp=max(comps,key=len)
    rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in comp]
    dh,dw=max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    # patterned object is contiguous non-bg patch distinct from destination
    others=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in set(comp)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in others); r1=max(r for r,c in others); c0=min(c for r,c in others); c1=max(c for r,c in others)
    pat=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    # demo shows 4x4 pattern copied into destination, rotated 180 degrees
    pat=[row[::-1] for row in pat[::-1]]
    for i in range(dh):
        for j in range(dw): g[min(rs)+i][min(cs)+j]=pat[i%len(pat)][j%len(pat[0])]
    return g
PY
